description: This script provides various functions related to platform-specific upgrade checks and procedures for different hardware models in an embedded Linux environment, primarily for use in OpenWRT firmware upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks for existing partition conditions (like jffs2 or ubi_rootfs) on specific boards before upgrading, to prevent overwriting important data.

methods.name: askey_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade by extracting root filesystem from a given tarball and writing it to flash, then runs NAND upgrade.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade for ZyXEL devices by extracting kernel and root filesystem from a tarball and writing them to their respective partitions.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function delegating to specific upgrade procedures based on board name.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files to specific devices, e.g., eMMC configuration for certain models.
